A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Insight-V study and contain readable main text, equations, Tables 1–4, Figures 1–6, and Appendices A–C. The complete material supports reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original Insight-V benchmark evaluations and ablations in Section 4, plus an MMStar reasoning/answer analysis in Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, qualitative comparisons, and Appendix B analysis. These retained empirical outcomes qualify as original results.

M1.justification: The structured reasoning-data pipeline, reasoning and summary agents, supervised fine-tuning, and iterative DPO procedure in Section 3 and Appendix A are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training-data sources, seven reasoning benchmarks, and additional TextVQA, DocVQA, OCRBench, and AI2D evaluations. Appendix B retains the same MMStar scenario.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 1–4 and Figures 5–6, including external MLLMs, direct SFT, multi-turn supervision, summary-only, and RLAIF/DPO training variants.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3 retain the same model sizes, sample sizes, learning rates, epochs, evaluation procedures, and three DPO rounds. No experimental settings are revised.

E4.justification: The agent-design and DPO ablations, training-data scaling study, qualitative example, and Appendix B robustness analysis are unchanged, including Tables 3–4 and Figures 4–6.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-result reporting. Neither adds repeated-run or seed information, confidence intervals, uncertainty estimates, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All table entries, plotted results, and qualitative outcomes match. Table 1 retains averages of 47.2 for Insight-V-LLaVA and 51.6 for Insight-V; Figure 6's confusion matrices are also identical.

T1.justification: The reasoning-generation equations, preference definitions, Bradley–Terry formulation, and reward-model likelihood expression in Sections 3.2 and 3.4.2 are unchanged. No theoretical results or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical contributions and claims concerning scalable reasoning data, multi-agent reasoning, iterative DPO, and preservation of perception performance.

C2.justification: The result interpretations and Appendix C limitations are unchanged, including sampling efficiency, two-model scalability, and reasoning quality. The limitations merely continue at different page positions.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix A retain identical implementation details, including 16 sampled outputs, preference-score thresholds, and beta = 0.1. Code access information is unchanged; the new acknowledgement only identifies funding.

R1.justification: Section 2, research positioning, and all 58 reference entries are unchanged. Reference text is reflowed without additions or removals.

P1.justification: v2 inserts an Acknowledgement section between the conclusion and appendix and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific prose and organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgement shifts appendix text and Figure 6 downward on page 9 and reflows subsequent limitations and references. Figure and table contents, captions, and designs remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 adds funding attribution and makes limited layout adjustments. Methods, empirical evidence, claims, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, and the reflow does not materially affect readability. Overall paper quality is essentially unchanged.
